# Tomatick

> Tomatick is a free, open-source menu bar app that combines a timer,
> stopwatch, alarm and pomodoro in a single menu bar icon, with a timestamped
> history of every session. It runs entirely on the user's machine — no
> accounts, no uploads, no server-side processing. Rewritten as a single Go
> binary; distributed under the MIT license.

## Docs
- [Quick Start](https://tomatick.us/docs/): install and use every feature — timer, stopwatch, pomodoro, alarms, presets, hotkey, Focus/DND, settings sync.

Available for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows (x86_64), and Linux (x86_64). All builds are unsigned.

## Source & downloads
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/MichalAFerber/tomatick2): source code (Go), issues, releases.
- [Releases](https://github.com/MichalAFerber/tomatick2/releases): download the latest `.zip` (macOS), `.exe` (Windows), or `.tar.xz` (Linux).

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://tomatick.us/privacy/): local-only data; cookieless, self-hosted Plausible analytics on the site.
- [Terms of Use](https://tomatick.us/terms/): MIT license terms; provided as-is.
